Each of the four submitted HTTPS sources must be fetchable.

The contract source must expose those named methods.
The README and live interface must describe publishing, exact funding, evidence delivery, validator review, Builder payment, Client refund, and public history without contradictory settlement rules.
APPROVED permits the Builder to claim exactly 0.02 GEN; any material mismatch requires revision, and REJECTED permits the Client refund under the funded rule.
